steps: A robot joint needs a big speed reduction in a small space. Two planetary stages in series give about 12:1.
Input: the motor (not modelled) turns brass sun gear 1, which has 24 teeth.
Planets (18 teeth) roll between the sun and the fixed ring (60 teeth). Carrier 1 turns at 24 / (24 + 60) = 2/7 of input speed.
Carrier 1 carries sun gear 2, so sun 2 turns at the same speed. The same 2/7 reduction repeats in stage 2.
Output: carrier 2 turns (2/7) squared = 4/49 of input speed, about one turn per 12.25 input turns, in the same direction.
Exploded view. Schematic: bearings, seals, housing walls and the motor are not modelled. No strength or torque check is made.
